5607751b158339ef.description: About the Role Entity Asia Contracting Company is seeking a QA/QC Welding Inspector to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern Region. This full-time role is critical for ensuring that all welding activities comply with project specifications, approved welding procedures, Saudi Aramco standards, and international quality codes. The inspector will be responsible for conducting thorough welding inspections and verifying quality documentation. Role Overview The Welding QC Inspector will play a key role in monitoring and inspecting welding operations to uphold stringent quality and safety requirements. This involves supporting client inspections, managing non-conformance reports, and maintaining comprehensive inspection records to ensure all welding work meets the highest standards. Key Responsibilities Perform inspections of welding activities in accordance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), project specifications, and international codes. Conduct fit-up, in-process, and final welding inspections. Verify welder qualifications, welding consumables, and welding equipment before the commencement of work. Ensure compliance with Saudi Aramco quality requirements and project specifications. Review welding procedures, inspection reports, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) reports, and other quality documentation. Coordinate with construction, QA/QC, and client representatives during inspections. Raise and monitor Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and ensure corrective actions are implemented effectively. Maintain accurate inspection records, quality reports, and documentation. Support client audits and quality inspections. Ensure adherence to Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies and quality management systems. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related Engineering discipline. Minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in Saudi Aramco projects as a Welding QC Inspector. Saudi Aramco CBT (Computer-Based Test) Passed – Mandatory. Strong knowledge of welding inspection procedures, WPS, Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), ITP, and international welding codes. Ability to interpret engineering drawings and welding documentation. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed upon application. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

568cc5231da493ad.description: About the Role Astek Middle East is seeking a Senior Web Analytics & CRO Specialist to enhance the measurement, analysis, and optimization of digital customer journeys within a high-volume transactional eCommerce environment. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with work opportunities in Jeddah and Makkah, and requires 5-10 years of experience. This is a hands-on, implementation-focused role. The specialist will ensure accurate tracking of customer interactions, reliable analytics implementations, and the translation of behavioral insights into measurable improvements in conversion and digital experience. The role is technical, focusing on web/product analytics and CRO, rather than general digital marketing or campaign reporting. Key Responsibilities Web Analytics Implementation & Measurement: Implement, configure, audit, and troubleshoot GA4 and GTM, including tags, triggers, events, and parameters. Own tracking plans, event taxonomies, data-layer requirements, and QA checklists. Validate browser-side, cross-domain, consent-aware, and server-side tracking. Use GTM Preview, GA4 DebugView, and browser developer tools to identify tracking issues and conduct release regression testing. Behavioral Analytics & Customer Journey Diagnostics: Configure and analyze behavioral analytics tools such as Hotjar or Microsoft Clarity. Use session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel analysis to identify abandonment points and usability friction. Translate findings into prioritized, actionable recommendations for Product, UX, and Engineering teams, while applying privacy safeguards. Conversion Rate Optimization & Experimentation: Develop evidence-based hypotheses and measurement plans for A/B tests. Support experiment implementation, targeting, QA, and interpretation of results using platforms like VWO or Optimizely. Maintain a prioritized CRO opportunity backlog and collaborate with stakeholders to drive measurable improvements. Data Quality, Attribution & Analytics Enablement: Establish tracking standards, UTM governance, and conversion tracking quality controls. Investigate and reconcile discrepancies between GA4, marketing reports, and backend transaction systems. Use SQL and BigQuery to validate GA4 exports and support business intelligence datasets. Document implementations, audit findings, and deliver knowledge-transfer sessions. Expected Deliverables An initial tracking and analytics tooling audit with prioritized remediation recommendations. A documented measurement framework, event taxonomy, data-layer specifications, and tracking QA procedures. A prioritized CRO experimentation backlog supported by behavioral and funnel analysis. Improved tracking completeness and reduced discrepancies between analytics and backend transactions. Documented experiment results, implementation standards, and knowledge-transfer materials. Candidate Requirements Applicants should demonstrate personal implementation, debugging, and validation experience. Experience limited to reviewing GA4 dashboards, reporting campaign performance, managing paid media, SEO, or optimizing marketing campaigns will not meet the core requirements. Essential Requirements: At least five years of hands-on technical web or product analytics implementation experience, preferably within transactional eCommerce, insurance, financial services, or self-service digital products. Advanced practical experience implementing and debugging GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Demonstrated ownership of event tracking, data-layer design, tagging specifications, conversion measurement, and implementation QA. A current, verifiable Google Analytics certification (evidence must be provided with CV). Working knowledge of JavaScript, browser developer tools, HTTP requests, and web tracking fundamentals. Hands-on experience with at least one behavioral analytics platform and one A/B testing or experimentation platform. Proven ability to investigate tracking defects, validate transactional conversion events, and translate journey data into prioritized recommendations. Experience collaborating directly with frontend/backend developers, Product, UX, and external technology vendors. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Preferred Qualifications: Practical experience with Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, FullStory, Contentsquare, VWO, Optimizely, or AB Tasty. SQL, BigQuery, GA4 export analysis, or Power BI integration experience. Familiarity with Adobe Analytics, Tealium, Amplitude, Mixpanel, consent management, or server-side tagging. Experience in insurance, banking, fintech, or transactional eCommerce. Additional certifications in Google Tag Manager, experimentation, or product analytics.

56b62c16e96056a3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يهدف هذا الدور إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام من خلال مراقبة أماكن العمل ومنافذ الدخول. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول والخروج من المنشأة، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، ومنحهم تصاريح الدخول. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. التجول بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والحوادث، والتحقيق فيها، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الممتلكات ضد السرقة والتخريب. مهارات جيدة في الملاحظة والتواصل. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في عنيزة، القصيم. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

566cd7ad9d27585e.description: نبحث عن مشرف مبيعات يتولى قيادة فريق المبيعات ومتابعة مساري البيع للشركات والمنشآت (B2B) والأفراد والمنازل، والعمل على تحقيق المستهدفات وتنمية قاعدة العملاء. نبحث عن شخص عملي يجمع بين الإشراف على الفريق والمشاركة المباشرة في البيع والتفاوض وإغلاق الصفقات. المهام والمسؤوليات: إعداد خطة المبيعات الشهرية، وتوزيع المستهدفات على الفريق، ومتابعة تحقيقها لكل مسار. الإشراف على مندوبي المبيعات، وتنظيم أعمالهم وزياراتهم، وتقييم أدائهم وتطوير مهاراتهم. استقطاب عملاء جدد، وتنمية مبيعات العملاء الحاليين، وإعادة التواصل مع العملاء المنقطعين. متابعة احتياجات العملاء ومعالجة المشكلات، والتنسيق مع التشغيل والمستودع لضمان تنفيذ الطلبات. المشاركة في التفاوض وإغلاق الصفقات، والالتزام بالأسعار والخصومات والصلاحيات المعتمدة. متابعة التحصيل والمبالغ المستحقة بالتنسيق مع الإدارة المالية. إعداد تقارير دورية توضح المبيعات، ونسب تحقيق المستهدفات، وأداء المندوبين، والتحديات والحلول المقترحة. رصد احتياجات السوق وأسعار المنافسين، ورفع مقترحات عملية لتطوير المبيعات. تحديد احتياج الفريق من الموظفين، والمشاركة في المقابلات وترشيح المناسبين لاعتمادهم من الإدارة. المتطلبات: خبرة عملية في المبيعات ومتابعة فرق البيع، ويفضّل في مبيعات الشركات والمنشآت. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتفاوض وبناء العلاقات مع العملاء. القدرة على تنظيم العمل، ومتابعة الأرقام، وإعداد تقارير المبيعات باستخدام Excel. المبادرة وتحمل المسؤولية والاستعداد للعمل الميداني ومتابعة الفريق والعملاء.

5682ccec0463349a.description: About Saudi Aramco Saudi Aramco | أرامكو السعودية is seeking a Lead Corporate Strategist to join its Corporate Strategy Department. This department is directly responsible for the company's strategy development and update processes, applying best practices across upstream, downstream, new energies, and corporate strategy fields. Role Overview The Lead Corporate Strategist will focus on the strategic assessment of industrial portfolio sectors. This full-time role involves evaluating investment opportunities and providing actionable recommendations to Executive Management. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Advise Executive Management and senior leadership on strategic priorities and long-term plans for industrial portfolio businesses. Lead sector-level strategic assessments across industries such as mining, shipbuilding, manufacturing, technology, and other diversified sectors. Develop data-driven strategic recommendations supported by market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and financial evaluation for industrial portfolio businesses. Generate and propose diversified growth options, including acquisitions, partnerships, joint ventures, and organic expansion initiatives for new or existing portfolio sectors. Lead special studies and strategic research initiatives for Executive Management and the Company Board on industrial sectors within the portfolio. Act as a bridge between fundamental market research and disciplined financial execution. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline from an accredited university. An advanced degree is preferred. Minimum of 15 years of experience in Industrial/Mining/Energy companies, Management Consulting, Private Equity, or Investment Banking. At least 5 years of experience in strategy or transaction advisory, or demonstrated experience in diversified portfolio management and multi-sector investment strategy. Advanced expertise in financial modeling, valuation, and investment analysis. Extensive experience operating within large, complex corporate environments, with an understanding of matrixed decision-making and driving collaboration across multiple departments and functions. Strong knowledge of market dynamics, investment trends, regulatory environments, commercialization models, and market entry strategies across multiple industrial sectors. Proven commercial acumen and experience in business development in one or more industrial sectors. Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex data into clear, compelling strategic recommendations. Executive-level communication skills, with a proven ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives. 565defcdde17e445.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رؤية الحلول للطاقة عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية للشركة من خلال دراسة السوق، تطوير استراتيجيات البيع، وإدارة علاقات العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمواهب الطموحة لبدء مسيرتها المهنية في قطاع الطاقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول الملائمة. عرض وتوضيح التقارير وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتقديم العروض التقديمية بوضوح. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل. بيئة العمل سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق ديناميكي في مقر الشركة بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير المهارات المهنية والشخصية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال مراحل المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

564ed4c48b5de96d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة العمرو للاستشارات الهندسية عن أخصائي إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، بالمنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، ويهدف إلى دعم التنسيق والمتابعة الفعالة للمشاريع الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنسيق فعال بين المشاريع المختلفة وعناصر الإشراف لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. التواصل المستمر والفعال مع فريق الإشراف لتبادل المعلومات وتحديثات التقدم. المتابعة الدورية لجميع جوانب المشاريع لضمان الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية والمعايير المحددة. متابعة وتحليل التقارير الواردة من مختلف عناصر المشروع لتقييم الأداء وتحديد مجالات التحسين. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو ما يعادله. القدرة على التنسيق الفعال بين الأطراف المتعددة داخل المشروع. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، كتابية وشفوية. القدرة على متابعة التقارير وتحليل البيانات المتعلقة بالمشاريع. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق متخصص في مجموعة العمرو للاستشارات الهندسية، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لدعم العمليات اليومية للمشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. هذه فرصة للمرشحين الطموحين لبناء مسيرة مهنية في قطاع الاستشارات الهندسية.

56a3b7ece3cfd161.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ساعد أزكى عن مأمور سنترال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على عمليات تشغيل مقسمات الهاتف، وإدارة المكالمات الواردة والصادرة، وضمان سير العمليات الاتصالية بكفاءة عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى مأمور السنترال مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع عمليات تشغيل مقسمات الهاتف، بما في ذلك إجراء المكالمات واستقبالها والرد عليها. كما يشمل الدور الإبلاغ عن أي مشكلات فنية وتسجيل الرسائل الموجهة للموظفين أو العملاء وترحيلها لضمان استمرارية الاتصال الفعال داخل الشركة وخارجها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تشغيل مقسمات الهاتف ولوحات تحويل الاتصالات ووحدات التحكم الخاصة بها لتوصيل المكالمات وتعليقها وتحويلها وقطعها. الرد على المكالمات الواردة بمهنية، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة للمتصلين، وتحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام المعنية، وتلقي الرسائل وترحيلها حسب الحاجة. متابعة حالة الأجهزة الهاتفية والمقسمات، والتأكد من سرعة الإبلاغ عن أي أعطال في الأجهزة أو الخطوط لضمان صيانتها في أقرب وقت ممكن. ضمان الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل والتقيد بها. رفع التقارير الفنية الدورية للإدارة حول سير العمل وتوضيح الصعوبات والتحديات التي قد تعيقه. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة مقسمات الهاتف ولوحات التحويل. مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع المتصلين. بيئة العمل يعمل مأمور السنترال في بيئة مكتبية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق يدعم العمليات اليومية للشركة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمواعيد العمل المحددة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة في شركة ساعد أزكى بالرياض.

56ce82b61925cd73.description: About Red Sea Global and the Role Red Sea Global (RSG) is seeking a Manager Dive Center to join its subsidiary, Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE). RSSE is responsible for developing and delivering land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination, managing a portfolio that includes water sports through Galaxea. This full-time, site-based leadership role is located in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The Manager Dive Center will oversee the overall management, performance, and daily operations of the GALAXEA Dive Center. Role Purpose and Context The Manager Dive Center ensures the safe, efficient, and high-quality delivery of all diving activities, courses, and guest experiences, adhering to luxury hospitality standards and international diving regulations. This position is accountable for operational excellence, team leadership, asset readiness, and commercial performance, contributing to GALAXEA's growth as a world-class diving destination. The role requires flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and peak seasons, involving both operational leadership and guest-facing responsibilities. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all daily operations of the GALAXEA Dive Center, including scheduling, resource allocation, and guest flow. Ensure all diving activities are conducted safely, professionally, and in compliance with SOPs and training agency standards. Deliver exceptional, personalized diving experiences aligned with luxury service standards and manage guest feedback. Lead, mentor, and manage a team of instructors, divemasters, technicians, and marine crew, overseeing recruitment, training, and performance. Ensure the highest standards of safety across all dive operations, enforcing compliance with international diving standards (*, PADI or equivalent) and local regulations. Oversee the maintenance, servicing, and readiness of all dive equipment, vessels, and facilities, including accurate inventory management. Manage all dive center revenue streams, monitor financial performance, and optimize retail offerings. Support the setup, testing, and operational readiness of the Dive Center and contribute to the development of SOPs and safety protocols. Champion marine conservation and responsible diving practices, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. Maintain accurate operational, financial, and safety records, providing regular performance reports to senior management. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in dive center management or a related field. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing operational teams within a hospitality or recreational diving context. Strong understanding of international diving regulations and safety standards (*, PADI or equivalent). Experience in financial management, budgeting, and revenue optimization for dive operations. Proven ability to foster a high-performance, safety-driven, and collaborative team environment. Work Environment This is a site-based role at the GALAXEA Dive Center within The Red Sea destination in Umluj, Tabuk. The position is full-time and requires adaptability to work schedules that include weekends, holidays, and peak seasons to meet operational demands. The role involves direct interaction with guests and leadership of a diverse team.

56f96bf5fa966617.description: About the Role AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is seeking a Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in central Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to AWS's growth strategy in the Kingdom, which is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, driven by Vision 2030 and national digital transformation programs across various sectors. Role Overview The Solutions Architect serves as a key technical advisor for a portfolio of enterprise customers. This involves assisting them in modernizing legacy platforms, adopting AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerating their digital agendas. The role requires strategic thinking about business, products, and technical challenges, operating at the intersection of technology and business. Key Responsibilities Support long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions, in partnership with Account Managers and Business Development. Serve as a technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Riyadh and central Saudi Arabia region, building relationships with stakeholders and contributing to their technology strategy. Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and participate in architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful cloud deployment, including competitive migration paths. Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers using or considering AWS (*, Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays). Capture and share best-practice knowledge within the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures. Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support, gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and collaborating with fellow Solutions Architects in the region. Daily Activities A typical day involves reviewing architecture proposals for enterprise customers, participating in technical sessions with engineering teams to design application platforms, and advising on the appropriate mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services. The role also includes collaborating with account teams on strategy calls, supporting workshops or Immersion Days for developers, and contributing to internal knowledge sharing. The focus remains on being a trusted technical partner for customers, directly driving their success on AWS. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of experience in a relevant technical role. Broad technical competence across multiple areas, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, and data analytics. Demonstrated depth in at least 1-2 of the aforementioned technical areas. Ability to connect technology solutions with measurable business value for customers. Experience interacting with various customer stakeholders, including Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers. About the Team The AWS Global Sales team drives the worldwide adoption of the AWS cloud, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand. 567511557898ec91.description: The Project Manager’s role is essential in ensuring the successful delivery of projects. The role holder will lead the implementation of small to large projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams and a range of internal and external stakeholders. This role will deploy the full range of the department’s tools and processes to ensure the successful design and deployment and delivery of all assigned projects throughout their full lifecycles with a strong focus on achieving the intended benefits and operational performance goals. General Responsibilities Manage and execute projects under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager and the Project Delivery Lead Management to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with predefined and agreed objectives and quality standards. Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, and budgets. Continuously monitor project progress, identifying and addressing issues, risks and changes as they arise. Work with the Director Project Delivery Lead Management to define project milestones/objectives and deliverables for projects and establish a framework for monitoring and reporting project performance. Collaborate with project team members to identify and implement improvement strategies that enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness and mitigate issues and risks. Work closely with various departments within the Centre of Excellence (COE) to ensure seamless coordination and alignment of project activities with overall business objectives. Foster effective communication and collaboration among project team members and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned with project goals, objectives and the status of all assigned projects. Implement and uphold rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure that projects meet or exceed quality standards and customer expectations. Conduct regular project audits to verify adherence to established quality guidelines and identify areas for improvement. Identify potential project issues, risks, changes and collaborate within the Project Delivery Teams to develop contingency and mitigation plans to proactively address challenges that may impact project delivery. Allocate and manage project resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, and equipment, to optimize project delivery and ensure the efficient utilization of resources. Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, all project logs and documentation of lessons learned, in line with organizational standards. Provide regular updates and reports on project status to the Director Project Delivery Lead Management, Chief Operational Excellence Officer, and relevant stakeholders. Recommend training and development interventions for team members to build their capabilities. Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency. Implement all relevant Department’s policies, processes, procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies, and standards. Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required. Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred. PMP or Prince2 certification is required. Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written business English. 7+ years of experience in project management or a related field preferably into Supplychain industries, including planning, execution, delivery, and reporting. Proven experience in project management, including planning, execution, delivery, reporting and effective communication. Experience working with leadership and senior stakeholders and coordinating across internal cross-functional teams. Experience with any one of PMP-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, or structured reporting and governance. Broader experience across PMP-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, and structured reporting and governance is preferred. Experience in logistics and supply chain projects is preferred.

567f8da6c1437d49.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why This Role Matters At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work - not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised. This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal - not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction. If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well - this role is for you. What You Will Do Own delivery from pre-RFP to go-live. Lead pre-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made. Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery - with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle. Ensure every project proposal goes through cross-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door. Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness. Run governance like it matters - because it does. Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision-making checkpoints. Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks. Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility - not a sanitised summary. Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made. Run post-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation. Keep every part of the business aligned. Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery. Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings - and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read. Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements. Manage third-party and vendor risk. Oversee vendor and third-party onboarding governance - tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project. Maintain a Third-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities. Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners. Bring the same rigour to internal programmes. Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives - process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes. Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership. Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use. You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises. Who You Are You have 5+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice. You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them. You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise. You have real financial acumen - cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off. You can influence without authority. You work across functions where you do not control the resources, and you still get things done. Your communication is clear, structured, and calibrated to the audience - whether that is an engineer, a client, or a CEO. You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. You apply methodology pragmatically - the framework serves the project, not the other way around. You are comfortable in a fast-scaling environment where not everything is defined. You build the structure and improve it as you go. Culturally, you are: Structured but not rigid. Proactive, not reactive. Calm when it gets complicated - and it will get complicated. Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. What the Hiring Process Will Look Like Screening call with Talent Acquisition Deep-dive interview with the Head of Services Case study presentation - project governance and risk scenario Offer
